name: Bohemian
what_it_means: Bohemian (boho) design feels warm, earthy and handcrafted: terracotta, sand, olive and mustard tones, arches, sun and moon motifs, woven and rug-like patterns, botanical illustrations and relaxed serif type. It evokes travel, freedom and slow artisanal living.
signature_moves: Earthy palette: terracotta, sand, olive, mustard
Arches, suns, moons, wavy organic shapes
Botanical line drawings and dried flowers
best_for: Home décor, ceramics, yoga retreats, travel, handmade goods
prompt_template: B U I L D Y O U R U I R E P L A C E T H E [ B R A C K E T S ] ** Design an online store homepage for [HANDMADE / DECOR BRAND] in a Bohemian (boho) style. Warm sand background (#F3E5D0). Use arch-shaped image frames, a half-sun with rays, a crescent moon and wavy organic shapes in terracotta (#C8633F), olive (#8A9A5B) and mustard (#E0A84E). Add a woven rug-style pattern strip and a few botanical line drawings (pampas grass, leaves). Headline in a soft, warm serif (Fraunces / DM Serif Display) in brown (#5A3A2E) with a handwritten accent word. Rounded, earthy buttons. Relaxed, slightly asymmetric layout.
